purpose: Record, for every workflow that runs somebody else's project, which decision it guards and whether it still tests what the pin registry says was qualified.
how_to_read: guards: the decision that would be taken differently if this lab failed. null means it has not been arbitrated; a blocking lab with null is counted against the ceiling below.
Deciding which labs deserve a blocking slot is an arbitration for a human. This file records the answers, it does not produce them.

targets: every literal env value in the workflow that pins an external identifier, mapped to the external-pins.json entry it corresponds to, or null when it is not a governed external target. An undeclared one fails the check, so a new hardcoded target cannot appear unnoticed.

A declared target whose literal has drifted from the registry means the lab qualifies a combination the repository no longer claims to have qualified, while its green tick reads exactly like one that does.

labs.note: HERMES_LANGFUSE_PLUGIN_BLOB names a blob inside the Hermes tree, not an independently pinned project.
Langfuse has no entry in external-pins.json at all, so this lab qualifies against a target the registry does not govern.
